GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well eased back 5-6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 4l off all clear, ran on strong taking lead late # back/ran on strong

Jumped Ok drifted back 7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide without cover for the majority of the race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 8l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 5l off all clear, kept on one pace # back/no threat

Jumped Ok sat 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly through the middle stages. Near the 900m was steadied when awkwardly placed inside the heels of another runner. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased to last 6l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on well but never a threat # good 4 further

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it travelled keenly early, dropped the bit when pressured at 600m and was disappointing to the line. Post-race vet exam revealed it to be 2/5 lame in the near foreleg. Vet clearance required.] # Pulled up lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated the gelding travelled keenly in the early stages, and when placed under pressure near the 600m it dropped the bit and was disappointing in its run to the line. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be lame (2/5) in the near foreleg. Trainer was told a vet clearance would be required before its next trial or race start. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 4-5l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, running on 1 length off 100m, kept finding the line, got the bob # hit line well
Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up half clear, headed approaching 200m, kept on ok final 100m # led/headed 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported it was not his intention to lead the race, but after the gelding began well and when other runners failed to display sufficient speed, he was left racing in the lead without having to pressure his mount.
